name: @withlaplace/yale-som-cms-mcp

tools.name: cms_session_status
tools.description: Verify the dedicated CMS browser login and show whether a previous submission needs reconciliation. If signed out, run local login with the same profile and browser.

tools.name: cms_get_dashboard
tools.description: Read announcements, recommendations, and your dashboard calendar.

tools.name: cms_search_jobs
tools.description: Search job postings, with filters and real continuation cursors. Read application methods and deadlines before acting.

tools.name: cms_get_job
tools.description: Read a job, eligibility, application documents, and native or external application instructions.

tools.name: cms_list_applications
tools.description: Read your applications and their authoritative status.

tools.name: cms_get_application
tools.description: Read one of your applications and its current status.

tools.name: cms_list_interviews
tools.description: Read your interviews and available scheduling options.

tools.name: cms_get_interview
tools.description: Read one interview schedule and exact slot identities.

tools.name: cms_search_events
tools.description: Search events and registration deadlines, with filters and pagination.

tools.name: cms_get_event
tools.description: Read event eligibility, registration state, and exact time slots. Unavailable slots cannot be booked.

tools.name: cms_search_appointments
tools.description: Search coaching and other appointment types and available slots. Use offset timestamps for date bounds.

tools.name: cms_get_appointment
tools.description: Read an appointment or slot and its current booking state.

tools.name: cms_get_calendar
tools.description: Read your calendar or career-center calendar, with explicit Eastern Time offsets.

tools.name: cms_search_employers
tools.description: Search the employer directory, including filters and continuation.

tools.name: cms_get_employer
tools.description: Read employer details, contacts, recruiting activity, jobs, and events.

tools.name: cms_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts available to your student account.

tools.name: cms_get_contact
tools.description: Read one permitted contact and student-editable personal tracking information.

tools.name: cms_list_targets
tools.description: Read your target employers or contacts, priorities, and statuses.

tools.name: cms_list_tasks
tools.description: Read your career tasks, filters, due dates, and status.

tools.name: cms_get_task
tools.description: Read a specific career task.

tools.name: cms_get_activity
tools.description: Read recruiting activity with filters and pagination.

tools.name: cms_get_profile
tools.description: Read your profile, job preferences, education, and experience. Use form discovery for editable fields.

tools.name: cms_list_documents
tools.description: Read application-material metadata and available document categories.

tools.name: cms_list_resume_books
tools.description: Read resume books, deadlines, and your participation or approval status.

tools.name: cms_get_resume_book
tools.description: Read one resume book and its submission requirements.

tools.name: cms_search_resources
tools.description: Search resource folders and documents, including continuation.

tools.name: cms_get_resource
tools.description: Read one resource or folder and its permitted download references.

tools.name: cms_get_job_analytics
tools.description: Read Job IQ results with their data source, cohort filters, currency, and any suppressed or unavailable values.

tools.name: cms_list_offices
tools.description: Read school offices available through CMS.

tools.name: cms_get_office
tools.description: Read one school office.

tools.name: cms_list_saved_searches
tools.description: Read saved searches and alert schedules for the selected view.

tools.name: cms_get_settings
tools.description: Read your CMS account settings. External account consent remains interactive.

tools.name: cms_list_outcomes
tools.description: Read your employment statuses, experiences, and offer reports.

tools.name: cms_get_outcome
tools.description: Read one of your employment or offer reports.

tools.name: cms_get_capabilities
tools.description: Discover student areas and supported operations. Missing permissions or unrecognized workflows are explicitly unavailable; they are never successful empty results.

tools.name: cms_get_form
tools.description: Inspect an allowed operation's actual fields, choices, required documents, target state, and eligibility without populating or submitting the form. IDs come from corresponding read tools.

tools.name: cms_prepare_change
tools.description: Prepare one explicitly supported student change WITHOUT remote effects. Supply operation, area, discovered target/slot identifiers, exact field values, and explicit absolute paths for uploads. Show the entire preview, including all compound effects. Drafts expire after ten minutes.

tools.name: cms_commit_change
tools.description: Perform the exact preview once, only AFTER the user confirms all its details. Revalidates the account, target state, eligibility, and files. Never replay after failure or uncertainty. Inspect and reconcile partial results locally.

tools.name: cms_download_document
tools.description: Download a permitted CMS document into the configured downloads folder. Supply a document/resource ID from the corresponding read tool and optionally a plain file name. Existing files are never silently overwritten.

instructions: Use only student capabilities available to this authenticated Yale SOM CMS account. Discover fields with cms_get_form and show the entire cms_prepare_change preview before requesting confirmation. cms_commit_change requires approval of that exact preview; confirm:true is the caller's attestation, not proof of human consent. Retain MCP client approval controls. Never automatically retry a write. An uncertain or partial result requires inspection and explicit local reconciliation. External application websites and external OAuth consent require handoff. Read cursors and truncation indicators before claiming completeness. Never infer hidden or suppressed research data.
